rule_text.name: 702.201a
rule_text.rule: Inscribe represents an activated ability that functions while the card with inscribe is in its owner's hand and a static ability that functions while the card with inscribe is in the exile zone. “Inscribe (cost)” means “(cost), Reveal this card from your hand: Exile this card from your hand inscribed on a creature you control. Activate this ability only at any time you could cast a sorcery.” and “For as long as this card is inscribed on that creature, that creature has 'Whenever this creature attacks, you may copy the inscribed card and you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.'”

rule_text.name: 702.201b
rule_text.rule: Cards with this ability have the subtype Inscription.

rule_text.name: 702.201c
rule_text.rule: If an inscribed card somehow leaves exile, it will no longer be inscribed on that creature.

rule_text.name: 702.201d
rule_text.rule: If you copy an inscribe ability you control, only one of them will be able to exile the card from your hand and will the rest will do nothing.

rule_text.name: 702.201e
rule_text.rule: If you gain control of or copy an inscribe ability of a card you don't own, you will be unable to exile the card and the ability will do nothing.
